                        local-optimal tour (excludes the closing return edge)
        edge_n_used:    n*n symmetric matrix counting how many times each
                        edge has been penalised in previous iterations
    Returns:
        updated_edge_distance: modified n*n distance matrix to be used in
                               the next 2-opt local search
    """

    updated = edge_distance.copy().astype(np.float64)
    
    # Build set of undirected tour edges
    tour_edges = set()
    for i in range(n):
        u = local_opt_tour[i]
        v = local_opt_tour[(i + 1) % n]
        if u < v:
            tour_edges.add((u, v))
        else:
            tour_edges.add((v, u))
    
    # Parameters
    alpha = 0.1         # exponential penalty growth factor
    beta = 0.05         # reward factor for non-tour edges
    noise_std = 0.001   # standard deviation of Gaussian noise relative to original distance
    
    # Modify each undirected edge
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1, n):
            usage = edge_n_used[i, j]
            orig = edge_distance[i, j]
            if (i, j) in tour_edges:
                # Exponential penalty on tour edges
                factor = np.exp(alpha * usage)
                new_val = orig * factor
            else:
                # Diminishing reward on non-tour edges (encourage exploration)
                discount = beta / (1.0 + usage)
                new_val = orig * (1.0 - discount)
            updated[i, j] = new_val

    n = len(local_opt_tour)
    original_sum = np.sum(edge_distance)
    alpha = 0.05  # reduction factor

    tour_edges = set()
    for i in range(n):
        u = local_opt_tour[i]
        v = local_opt_tour[(i + 1) % n]
        if u < v:

        else:

                updated[j, i] = updated[i, j]   # preserve symmetry

    new_sum = np.sum(updated)
    if new_sum > 0:
        updated *= (original_sum / new_sum)

    return updated
